I found it a great travel companion, since it’s only 249g, easy to fly, and in most places you DON'T need a license. All the aerial shots in this trip were filmed with the Antigravity drone ✈️, and it’s honestly super convenient for travel filming.
If you also enjoy seeing places from a new angle!
Have fun flying ❤️✈️!

In this video, I’m traveling through the border region of China, Laos, and Myanmar, visiting the small town of Jingmaishan, a place famous for its ancient tea culture.
There, I reunited with a tea farmer I first met two years ago and helped him sell more of his tea within China. Along the journey, I explore the stunning landscapes of Yunnan and meet the incredibly warm and welcoming Dai people who call this region home.
